fact: At the 21 May 2026 launch of SUDAPASS, officials gave technical briefings on its integration with civil registry databases, and the project runs in coordination with the Interior Ministry's Civil Registry.

The police spokesman told Awal Alnahar in August 2024 that the civil registry system holds the national number together with birth and death certificates and marriage, divorce and inheritance subsystems, recovered and running to 13 April 2023.
